parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-21, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 27.0 | 38.35 | 38.35
2 | 28.6 | 3.21 | 41.56
3 | 27.8 | 26.07 | 67.63
4 | 30.8 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given VES (Vertical Electrical Sounding) data, we analyze the sequence of resistivities for groups of three consecutive layers.

The resistivities are:
- $\rho_1 = 27.0\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- $\rho_2 = 28.6\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- $\rho_3 = 27.8\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- $\rho_4 = 30.8\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$

**Step 1: Evaluate the first group (Layers 1, 2, 3)**
The resistivities are $27.0, 28.6, 27.8$.
- $\rho_1 < \rho_2$ ($27.0 < 28.6$)
- $\rho_2 > \rho_3$ ($28.6 > 27.8$)
According to the rules, $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ corresponds to the letter **K**.

**Step 2: Evaluate the second group (Layers 2, 3, 4)**
The resistivities are $28.6, 27.8, 30.8$.
- $\rho_2 > \rho_3$ ($28.6 > 27.8$)
- $\rho_3 < \rho_4$ ($27.8 < 30.8$)
According to the rules, $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ corresponds to the letter **H**.

**Conclusion:**
The sequence of letters for the 4-layer model is KH.

{"curve_type": "KH"}
